completeness.partial: Only {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} of {{TOTAL}} reading batches are represented in the supplied records. These are compact projections, with omissions recorded in packing.partial_reasons. State these limits in {{TARGET}}; do not imply that the full draft text or all evidence was supplied.
completeness.complete: All saved batches are represented by compact cards; this does not mean full source text was supplied.

record_policy: The supplied records may contain compact graph records and compiled reading-answer records. Preserve question identity, answer status, cited source/page scope, and uncertainty. Do not treat an unanswered, failed, or partial answer as a completed answer or as evidence for a paper claim. Treat generated_summary and answer judgments as generated intermediate material, not source evidence. Only evidence entries with a bound source_id and quote support a paper claim; scope_context is context only and must not support a positive claim. If packing reports omissions or partial_reasons, disclose them under 待核实与未覆盖. Never infer scope beyond recorded pages and question IDs. Every paper analysis must explicitly check human mobility data, building/built-environment data, and method naming, while preserving the existing questions. For each dataset, state its exact name/provider/version, spatial and temporal scope and sample coverage, record unit and spatial/temporal granularity, collection/production/preprocessing, public access route and licence/restrictions, and its actual use by method and stage. Keep train, validation/model selection, final test, calibration, inference conditions/inputs, parameter sources and background distinct; ambiguous validation stays ambiguous. Do not equate static population/POI/building proxies with observed mobility or building-level measurements. Separate raw, processed and synthetic data, and data availability from code availability or a currently verified download. For each method retain the original name and sourced acronym expansion, then distinguish author-stated naming rationale from a reader interpretation of the mechanism; if absent, write 未说明 rather than inventing a name origin. Report 未说明 within the read scope or 不适用 with a reason for every unchecked dimension, even when a paper appears unrelated to buildings. Cite the supplied source/page for positive facts; never convert partial or failed question coverage into negative facts. Do not rerun or overwrite previous analyses, notes or PDF annotations. When question_groups_summary.question_scope_index is present, resolve that zero-based index through packing.question_scopes to recover the exact ordered question IDs for that batch. This dictionary only deduplicates scope lists; per-batch incomplete_question_ids, missing, errors and answer status remain authoritative, and a shared scope does not mean shared evidence or completed answers.
